title: sync script: clean-path commit failure conflated with 'nothing to commit' — silent infinite retry loop
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 passes 1.2/3.6 (converged). sync-beads-workers.sh:274-279: any git commit failure (hook, disk) takes the same path as a legitimately-emptied merge: abort, no conflicted[] entry, exit 0. A branch whose only delta is .beads/oscore re-fails identically every run with no human signal. Fix: distinguish index-empty from commit-error; record the latter in conflicted[].
